case: Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America v. Walsh
form: Signed plenary lead announcing judgment; Opinion of the Court in part and plurality Medicaid application
assignment_authority_text: Stone-Zsela assigns the Commerce component as Chief Justice within its unanimous judgment coalition. Stevens assigns the Medicaid judgment-supporting lead as the senior Associate in the six-Justice affirmance coalition, which excludes Stone-Zsela. The common lead must preserve both sources of authority; because the Chief assigns a portion, the balanced-assignment rule governs the one lead. fit_notes.Souter: His full frozen application and Tracy work fit the predictive record and actual competitor analysis; he can state the common statutory limits without collapsing the divided Medicaid grounds.
